description: A site's transfer capability (ADR-0035) and the revision of the last SiteCapabilityChanged published for it. The revision only ever increases per site; 0 means no snapshot was ever published.

transferOriginEnabled.description: The site may donate stock to another site.

transferDestinationEnabled.description: The site may receive stock from another site.

capabilityRevision.description: Revision of the last published SiteCapabilityChanged for this site.
